annotations.title: Get the best time to go

description: Get the best time to visit from the Meridian Dispatch guides, in one of two modes. Give destination (a country, town, trail or ski resort) for its best months, good and avoid months, closures and crowds where known, the guide's own best-time line, and the events held there. Or give month for "where to go in March": up to 40 countries, towns, trails, ski resorts and festivals the guides recommend that month, each with its reason, events first. If both are given, destination wins. For festival dates alone use list_events; for a full planning guide use get_destination. Read-only. An unknown destination, an invalid month or neither parameter returns an error message.

destination.description: A country, town, trail or ski resort, by name, e.g. "Kotor" or "Niseko". Use this or month.

month.description: An English month name ("October", or "oct") or its number, 1 to 12 ("10"). Use this or destination.

region.description: With month: only this part of the world ("where in Asia in February"). Ignored with destination.

name: get_best_time

recommended.description: For a month: destinations recommended then.

best_time_line.description: When there is no why_now: the guide's best-time line for the whole year.

why_now.description: Why go this month, from the guide.

source.description: How to credit this answer: show cite_as, or link url.

cite_as.description: A ready-made citation line: title, publisher, date and URL.

corrections.description: How to report an error on this page (suggest_edit).

url.description: Link for the reader (carries referral tags).
